release.notes:
YouTube AI v0.1.3-beta

On macOS, normal Quit now stops the backend started by this application instead of leaving it on port 8765. The frozen app also bundles trusted CA roots so it can reach the public update feed over verified HTTPS. TLS certificate and hostname verification remain enabled.

Mac users upgrading from the published v0.1.2-beta must install v0.1.3-beta manually from the DMG. The v0.1.2-beta frozen updater cannot reach the feed, so it cannot perform this upgrade itself. A future release can test the normal in-app updater path from v0.1.3-beta.

Existing projects and settings remain in Application Support when the app is replaced. No Windows-specific fix is included in this candidate; physical Windows validation remains pending. macOS is ad-hoc signed and not notarized, so Gatekeeper may require Open Anyway. ffmpeg and ffprobe are not bundled.
